liveBreezeSynthesis.scope: Direct authenticated synthesis using the 0.4.3 streamBreeze adapter for one audition and six film clips.

limitations: The authenticated checks synthesized an audition and six demo narration clips. Browser streaming, hangup and barge-in used a controlled upstream in a real rc.5 browser session.
The account balance, invoiced amount, hardware microphone-to-speaker latency and listening quality on other devices were not measured.
This release adds no new verification of Electron, other operating systems, or long-term model learning.
